audio.text: Which of these two laptops would you recommend for writing papers?

options: I wrote my last paper on a completely different topic.
Yes, I'd happily recommend it to anyone.
The lighter laptop, since you'll carry it to class.
The store closes at nine o'clock tonight.

why.en: "Which" → a choice. A repeats "writing" and "papers" in another sense; B answers a which-question with "Yes".
why.tr: "Which" → seçim. A "writing" ve "papers" kelimelerini başka anlamda tekrar ediyor; B "hangisi" sorusuna "Yes" ile cevap veriyor.
why.es: "Which" → una elección. A repite "writing" y "papers" con otro sentido; B responde "Yes" a una pregunta de "cuál".
